description: Part-load electrical + thermal efficiency curves with ambient temperature derating; heat-to-power ratio derived from efficiency split

unit.name: Generic 200 kW SOFC-based CHP unit
unit.source: US DOE NETL, SOFC Program Review (2020); US EPA CHP Catalog (2017); Larminie & Dicks (2003), Fuel Cell Systems Explained, 2nd ed.

eta_el_rated.note: Electrical efficiency at rated load (SOFC: 45-60% LHV); conservative mid-range

eta_th_rated.note: Thermal (waste heat) efficiency at rated load; total ~82%

PLR_min.note: SOFC minimum stable PLR (gas reformer minimum flow)

el_plr_a.note: Electrical PLR constant: SOFC maintains higher part-load eta than heat engines

el_plr_c.note: Electrical PLR quadratic term; slight peaking near PLR=0.9-1.0

th_plr_a.note: Thermal PLR constant; heat loss proportionally larger at part load

temp_derating_pct_per_degC.note: Power derating above 25 degC (small effect for SOFC — electrochemistry, not air-density)
